recommendations.issue: Inconsistent food preparation, use of lower quality ingredients, or issues with recipe execution.
recommendations.action: Conduct a comprehensive audit of all menu items, focusing on ingredient sourcing, standardizing recipes, and implementing daily taste tests by a senior chef. Provide immediate retraining for kitchen staff on critical dishes.
recommendations.expected_impact: Significant improvement in taste, consistency, and overall food quality, leading to higher customer satisfaction and repeat business.

recommendations.issue: Insufficient staff training in customer service, understaffing leading to stress, or lack of management oversight.
recommendations.action: Implement a mandatory bi-weekly customer service training program for all front-of-house staff, focusing on attentiveness, politeness, and conflict resolution. Increase management presence during peak hours to provide real-time coaching and support.
recommendations.expected_impact: Enhanced customer interactions, improved staff morale, and a more welcoming dining experience.

recommendations.issue: Outdated decor, poor lighting, uncomfortable seating, or excessive noise levels.
recommendations.action: Allocate budget for a phased refresh of the dining area, starting with improved lighting, comfortable seating upgrades, and sound-dampening solutions (e.g., acoustic panels, soft furnishings).
recommendations.expected_impact: A more pleasant and inviting dining environment, encouraging longer stays and positive word-of-mouth.

recommendations.issue: Broad operational inefficiencies, lack of attention to detail, or specific unaddressed customer needs.
recommendations.action: Implement a daily 'manager walk-through' checklist covering all operational touchpoints (restrooms, table settings, music volume, temperature, staff appearance) and introduce a quick customer feedback survey (e.g., QR code) to identify specific pain points.
recommendations.expected_impact: Proactive identification and resolution of minor issues before they escalate, leading to a smoother overall customer experience.

recommendations.issue: Menu prices not aligning with perceived value, portion sizes, or quality of food/service.
recommendations.action: Review the menu pricing strategy against competitor offerings and ingredient costs. Consider adjusting portion sizes, enhancing presentation, or introducing value-driven specials to better align price with perceived value.
recommendations.expected_impact: Increased customer perception of value for money, potentially leading to higher sales and reduced price-related complaints.

recommendations.issue: Inadequate cleaning protocols, insufficient staff for cleaning, or lack of regular maintenance.
recommendations.action: Develop and enforce a detailed daily, weekly, and monthly cleaning checklist for all areas (kitchen, dining room, restrooms). Assign specific staff responsibilities and conduct daily spot checks by management.
recommendations.expected_impact: A consistently clean and hygienic environment, boosting customer confidence and comfort.

recommendations.issue: Inefficient kitchen operations, understaffing during peak hours, or poor table management.
recommendations.action: Analyze kitchen workflow and staffing levels during peak hours using POS data. Implement a kitchen display system (KDS) for better order management and cross-train front-of-house staff to assist with minor tasks during rushes.
recommendations.expected_impact: Reduced customer wait times for both service and food, improving overall dining flow and customer satisfaction.
